title: Ensure all open comments are resolved before merging
description: A reviewer's objection should not be mergeable away. Azure Repos can refuse to complete a pull request while any comment thread is active, which turns review comments into something that has to be answered rather than outlived.
remediation: Project settings -> Repositories -> <repository> -> Policies -> Branch Policies -> <default branch>: set "Check for comment resolution" to On and Required. To cover every repository at once, add it at Project settings -> Repositories -> All Repositories -> Policies -> Branch Policies -> + -> "Protect the default branch of each repository".
fixSummary: Require comment resolution at Project settings -> Repositories -> <repo> -> Policies.
